::: {.hero-section}

A concept-first deep-learning course: start from probability and gradients, build convolutional and sequence models, then reach Transformers, representation learning, multimodal systems, and generative models.

The public course site is intentionally small. Use it for the current lecture decks, the few notebooks that matter, assignments, and a compact reading list.

## Course at a glance

- **25 meetings** — including a compact calculus bridge before backpropagation.
- **One through-line** — model a distribution, define a loss, compute gradients, and learn representations that generalize.
- **Two working modes** — concise lecture decks for ideas; notebooks and assignments for implementation.
- **Current materials only** — the lecture-deck page is the source of truth for the sequence and PDFs.

## A practical rhythm

1. Preview the short reading or reference for the week.
2. Work through the lecture deck; the checkpoint MCQs expose a common misconception before the answer slide.
3. Run the linked notebook or interactive when a mechanism needs to be seen, not merely described.
4. Use assignments to turn a small implementation into evidence-backed analysis.

The course [Slack workspace](https://join.slack.com/t/dl26workspace/shared_invite/zt-43b3v79vb-bVZl1_sJVCrBkVMDsq5TYA) is the place for questions, clarifications, and announcements.
